svg.text: MAVIA ERD 1 — COURSE STRUCTURE AND CONTENT EXTRACTION
Courses, the approved outline, uploaded PDFs, the learning objects extracted from them, and the pipeline run log
PK = primary key FK = foreign key ? = nullable U = part of a unique constraint
unique (course, file_sha256) on LEARNING MATERIAL and on COURSE OUTLINE — the same file cannot be uploaded twice to one course.
unique (course, parent, order) on OUTLINE NODE, with a partial unique index covering root nodes, where parent IS NULL.
GENERATION RUN carries exactly one scope: a material for extraction and question runs, an outline node for publish runs (CHECK on kind).
NARRATION CLIP holds one generated clip per learning object per scope, replacing the playlists previously kept inside a material's generated_json blob.
LEARNING OBJECT.concept_id points at CONCEPT GROUP; that half of the model is drawn on ERD 2.
